reader_summary.overview: Chris and Rob Michalik are twin brothers and co-founders of Kinderhook Industries, a middle-market private equity firm overseeing $8 billion focused on healthcare services, environmental services. Chris and Rob joined me on Private Equity Deals to discuss one of their portfolio companies, Ironclad Environmental Services. This time around, we discuss their story attached at the hip.

key_points.text: Chris and Rob Michalik are twin brothers and co-founders of Kinderhook Industries, a middle-market private equity firm overseeing $8 billion focused on healthcare services.
Chris and Rob joined me on Private Equity Deals to discuss one of their portfolio companies, Ironclad Environmental Services.
We cover their background and path to starting Kinderhook, including rooming together for the first 26 years of their lives.
